rows.review_disposition: Administrative synthesis status is not a source uncertainty. Retire from the final semantic uncertainty population; exact whole-book independent completion will be certified separately only after final repairs.

Land tenure may be one coherent requirement only while ownership, leases and sharecropping remain distinct. Do not infer equivalence of small proprietorship and métayage or absorb later redistribution/consequences into the prerevolutionary unit.

Attribution does not compel a biography, but developed observation can be useful even if the person is not a political actor. Preserve Young’s actual observation treatment and other meaningful whole-book roles.
Accept selective regional routes while preserving distinct developed contrasts; a national umbrella cannot substitute for regional differences.

Accept the regional granularity principle as a proposed editorial disposition, conditional on exact final retention of developed contrasts and corrected local exclusions. No entity approval follows from this administrative assertion.
11–12 expressly distinguish contemporary feudal terminology, variable burdens, lordship versus ownership and blended leases. Retain this qualification with explicit source pages.
26–28 show permeability, uncertain population estimates and inequality within orders; legal status, wealth and elite political power do not coincide. Preserve estimates and differentiated categories.
The map-interior semantic permission conflicts with frozen scope. Replace it with caption-only map support and independent prose requirements under rendered scope v3.
Retire duplicate administrative synthesis-status uncertainty; actual completion belongs in the final review and repair receipt.
Distinct opinion, publicity, America and representative-institution arguments survive cross-chapter recurrence. A recurring person/name alone does not justify consolidation.

Named journals/institutions can be subordinate routes when their function matters. A mere title mention does not require an independently weighted subject; access must match actual print/censorship/opinion content.
Calas, Sirven, La Barre and Damiens carry different religious/legal mechanisms. Preserve direct routes and avoid flattening all into toleration or all into judicial cruelty.
64–65 wonder, Mesmerism and freemasonry have different explanatory roles. Preserve those differences; do not dictate an unsupported fixed priority relation between spectacle and conspiracy critique.
46 characterizes reconstruction as fragmentary. Preserve trend/expansion while avoiding a spurious exact production total.
56–57 distinguish contemporary anxiety about proliferating public constitutional debate from the author proving a sole causal path to1789. Retain attribution and multiple mechanisms.

58 says crop failures ended optimistic harvest conditions; freedom was blamed for shortages, and later controls drew famine-pact charges. Retain competing claims rather than asserting either allegation as fact.

63–64 distinguish second-hand idealization, better-informed veterans and the independent significance of a demonstrated institutional new start. Preserve both reception limits and the author’s causal emphasis.
Retire administrative synthesis-status uncertainty; it is not unresolved source meaning.

84–85 resolve the vague second-formulation pointer: hailstorm damaged anticipated tax receipts within an existing fiscal/political/credit crisis. It is a trigger/constraint, not the sole origin of collapse.

85 supplies suspension of payments and forced interest-bearing paper while calling the outcome bankruptcy. Preserve both historical vocabulary and operational event without modern insolvency-law implications.
Unavailable notes are a source limitation; replace body-only language so eligible captions and substantive supplied text remain permitted under the frozen policy.

72/78/80–81 show claims to national liberties alongside corporate rights, negotiated compromise, dissent and differing popular responses. Replace opaque second-formulation shorthand with the actual qualified interpretation.

Priority is an editorial judgment based on source importance and useful retrieval. Historical local priority is not automatically inherited; brief but crucial treatment is not disqualified merely by duration.
66–67/72 distinguish ordinary-account presentation, omitted war costs and Calonne’s charge amid uncertainty about whom to trust. Do not convert that controversy into proved fraud.
72 explicitly reports Mirabeau’s hostile financial allegations; criticism, confidence loss and established policy failure are distinct from adjudicated corruption.
84–85 support harvest expectations, tax arrears, lender incentives and political resistance together. Retain the multi-causal qualification rather than attributing bankruptcy solely to weather.
